gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject test is required.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

funding.value: Admitted Ph.D. students, including internationals, normally get guaranteed support (TA, RA or fellowship) covering living costs, fees, health insurance and non-resident tuition; international offers depend on passing UCLA's oral English test (TOP) in the first year.
funding.quote: International students are supported through a mix of fellowships, research assistantships, and teaching assistantships. Support is normally guaranteed for four years. | Offers of support for international students are conditioned on passing this exam within the first year.

also.quote: In recent years, we have been able to guarantee 5 years of full financial support to almost all students admitted to the Ph.D. program.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's (completed by enrolment); M.A. admissions are suspended, so applicants apply to the Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent, to be completed by the time of matriculation | Please note that admissions to the M.A. and M.A.T. programs have been suspended

notes: Ph.D. applicants need a GPA of at least 3.5 in upper-division mathematics.
